preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through ownership transfer)
Victim address must have a positive balance of BOND tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function with _from set to a victim address that holds BOND tokens, _to set to your address (owner), and _amount equal to the victim's balance. This will directly transfer tokens from the victim to the owner without requiring approval.
